title: Dreamland Cafe and the musicians behind her
summary: Bill Bottoms hires her at Dreamland where she sings softly to tables for tips; she lists the band members including Lil Hardin, Joe Oliver, Sidney Bechet, Pops Foster and Mae Brady.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: after me -- the Dreamland Cafe. Mr. Bottoms -- it was Bill Bottoms who was Joe Lewis' trainer first -- Joe Lewis' dietician, rather. So then I crossed over to Dreamland, and that's where the Lord put his arms around me. Honey, I went from there to everything. I just sang, and sang, and sang. And I used to -- I was slick, you know, because I was making a lot of money. I'd sing softly to the tables so the next table couldn't hear me so I could get that money for the next table.
And then I sang, and Lil Hardin was on piano. Baby Dodds was clarinet, I believe.
On drums. Sidney Bechet was on clarinet. Joe Oliver was on trumpet. The Minor Brothers were on drums, too.
No, Minor -- two twin brothers. And then Wellington Broad was on bass. And there was another old man on bass, who was he? Daddy somebody.
Yeah, Pops Foster. Then I'm trying to think of somebody else -- Mae Bradey, sometimes her band would play with me, too.
Yeah. She had a band, too. And sometimes her band would play.
